detail.title: 4+4MP Dual-Sight Bullet WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-MFW7442K1-Z7-T40 4+4MP Dual-Sight Bullet WizMind Network Camera Key Points • Dual-Lens, Dual-Channel Design Simultaneously Captures Detail and Panoramic Views • CH 1: 4 MP@30fps; CH 2: 4 MP@30fps • CH 1: 8-56mm Motorized Vari-focal Lens; CH 2: 3.6mm Fixed Lens • Built-in Dual Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • Smart Dual Light: Built-in IR and LED Lights with 3 Illumination Modes Supported • Instant Sound and Light Alerts Deter Intruders & Reduce Incidents • Supports 5 AI Functions, Applicable for Multi-scenario Targets Detection and Analysis • Rich Interface: Alarm In/Out 3/2; Audio In/Out 2/1; RS-485; BNC; SD card Max. 256GB Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Channel 1: 0.001 lux @F1.2(Color,30IRE) 0.0002 lux@F1.2(B/W,30IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on) Channel 2: 0.002 lux @F1.0(Color,30IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Channel 1: 120 m (393.70 ft) (IR)80 m (262.47 ft) (warm light) Channel 2: 20 m (65.62 ft) (warm light)
General.Field of View: Channel 1: Horizontal: 40° (W)–9° (T) Vertical: 22° (W)–5° (T) Diagonal: 46° (W)–10° (T) Channel 2: Horizontal: 81° Vertical: 43° Diagonal: 95°
General.Close Focus Distance: Channel 1: W: 1 m (3.28 ft); T: 2 m (6.56 ft) Channel 2: 2 m (6.56 ft)
General.W: Channel 1: 8 mm–56 mm 151 m (495.41 ft) Channel 2: 3.6 mm 80 m (262.47 ft)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire, fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection, people gathering, and parking detection
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, face mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); optimization time setting
General.Face Recognition: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, face mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); optimization time setting. Dahua Face Recognition Technology extracts attributes from the captured face, compares it against the attributes in the face library, and then identifies the person. Management of 5 group face libraries,Max supports face contrast in face library with 25,000 faces
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting, people counting in area and queue management, generating and exporting report (day/month/year); 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, human detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload. Motor vehicle attributes: license plate, vehicle type, vehicle color, vehicle logo, seatbelt, smoking, calling,etc. Non-motor vehicle attributes: type, color, number of people, top type and color ,helmet. Human body attributes: top/bottom type and color, bag, hat, gender, and umbrella. Face attributes: gender, age, expressions, glasses, face mask and beard.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Channel 1: 50 Hz Main Stream: 2688 × 1520@25 fps Sub stream: 704 × 576@25 fps Third stream: 1920 × 1080@25 fps 60 Hz Main Stream: 2688 × 1520@30 fps Sub stream: 704 × 480@30 fps Third stream: 1920 × 1080@30 fps Channel 2: 50 Hz Main Stream: 2688 × 1520@25 fps Sub stream: 704 × 576@25 fps Third stream: 1920 × 1080@25 fps 60 Hz Main Stream: 2688 × 1520@30 fps Sub stream: 704 × 480@30 fps Third stream: 1920 × 1080@30 fps
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–8192 kbps H.265: 32 kbps–8192 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; license plate recognition, people number error; tripwire; input error; intrusion; intensity change; fast moving; people counting; people gathering; motion detection; missing object; parking detection; loitering detection; defocus detection; face detection; abandoned object; stay detection; human detection; queuing stay time; people number error detection; face recognition; video tampering; scene changing
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; HTTPS; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; 802.1x; SNMP; Bonjour
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB); NAS
General.Browser: Plug-in: IE: IE 9 and later Chrome: Chrome 86 and earlier Firefox: Firefox 86 and earlier Without Plug-in: Edge Chrome: Chrome 86 and later Firefox: Firefox 86 and later
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1 CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU FCC: 47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B
